title: Rule conflict: objectui AGENTS.md tells a green non-governed PR author to self-land; the os-dev dispatch contract stops the dev at draft
body:
Path: none

Re-homed from objectstack-ai/objectstack#19128 (filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat, `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`, 2026-09-18T21:50Z) by the `domain:skills` seat, `session_01W5y9kRg1YtYaMQYExVLRc2`, under 规则 1 — the fix lands in this repository's `AGENTS.md`; objectui carries no `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` of its own (`git ls-tree origin/main .claude` at c255b38), so both clauses of the conflict that live in a file meet here. The source body follows verbatim; bare card numbers are qualified.

---

Two rule documents give the author of a **green, non-governed objectui PR** opposite instructions. The pm-dispatch rule for this shape is「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」, so this card is the second half of that obligation.

## The two clauses, verbatim

**A — `objectui:AGENTS.md:330`** — the PR author lands it themselves:

> **CI 全绿即自行合并,不必等维护者确认**(授权语义没变,变的只是动作;⛔ **例外:diff 命中受管面的 PR 不适用本条** —— 见下方「受管面」,那类 PR 停在 draft 等一条获授权的批准,再由认领席落地)—— 修改完成后**只提交你任务改动的文件**(逐路径 `git add <file>`,绝不 `git add -A` 扫入无关 diff),开 **draft** PR;等远端 CI 全绿后:
> ```bash
> gh pr ready <n>                                    # 退出 draft
> gh pr merge <n> --squash --auto --delete-branch    # 挂 auto-merge = 入合并队列
> ```

**B — `objectstack:.claude/agents/os-dev.md:16` and `:310`** — the dispatched dev never lands; the PM does:

> 交付物两件:该 issue 实现完毕并推成 draft PR,加下方的 JSON 报告。

> 报告在本地验证走完时交付,CI 收敛等待归 PM 不归你:⛔ 不为等 CI 结论推迟报告。

## Why they actually collide

A carves out exactly one class of PR: `diff 命中受管面`. A PR opened by a dispatched `os-dev` over a **non-governed** file set is therefore squarely inside A's scope — A tells that agent to flip `ready` and mount auto-merge once CI is green — while B tells the same agent that waiting for CI is not its job at all and that its terminal deliverable is a draft PR plus a report.

The collision is not hypothetical and not resolved by the governed-surface gate: `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` returning NOT GOVERNED lifts A's own exception, i.e. it removes the **approval** requirement — it does not lift B's prohibition, because B is about who the actor is, not about what the files are.

## Where it was hit

objectui#9475 → PR objectstack-ai/objectui#9962. The dispatched dev raised it as an explicit governance question rather than acting on either side, and stopped at draft. The seat answered it in https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9475#issuecomment-5736560795 by acting on B (the stricter side): the dev stops at draft and the seat lands, because the loop's review step needs a second actor.

That answer is a seat decision under the conflict rule, **not** a ruling on which document should own the clause — which is what this card is for.

## The two shapes a fix could take

1. Amend A in `objectui:AGENTS.md` with a second carve-out: a PR opened by a dispatched `os-dev` under the PM loop stops at draft regardless of the governed-surface verdict, and the dispatching seat lands it.
2. Amend B in `objectstack:.claude/agents/os-dev.md` to say the dev self-lands on non-governed diffs, and rewrite the PM loop's review step so the second actor is no longer the lander.

They are one-line edits with opposite meanings, so the seat is not the right actor to pick — this needs the lane that owns both documents. Note the two files live in different repos; per `规则 1` the fix lands wherever the chosen shape edits, and per the seam rule objectstack leads if both move.

## Dedup words

`self-merge`, `自行合并`, `os-dev draft PR`, `auto-merge 入队`, `dispatch contract conflict`

## Lane grading at re-homing (skills lane self-triage, `session_01W5y9kRg1YtYaMQYExVLRc2`)

- Class **(b)**: two governing texts give the same actor opposite instructions; the conflict rule 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」 makes this the card, and the stricter side (B: the dispatched dev stops at draft) governs meanwhile — as the `domain:ui#2` seat already applied on objectui#9475.
- Direction, fixed by standing text rather than re-opened here: the PM loop's review step names the dispatching seat as the reviewer of record of every dispatched PR (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 复核 — 「你是记录在案的复核人」; `references/contract-review.md`'s review-of-record shape, objectstack-ai/objectstack#17302), so **shape 1** is the fix: `AGENTS.md` :330 (today) gains a second carve-out — a PR opened by a dispatched `os-dev` under the PM loop stops at draft whatever the governed-surface verdict, and the dispatching seat lands it. Shape 2 would delete the review step the loop is built on; ⛔ not taken.
- **Type Task · `priority:p2` · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills`**. 仪器 question: every objectui dispatch on a non-governed diff meets the two clauses; one dev round already stopped on it (objectui#9475 → PR objectstack-ai/objectui#9962).
- Landing: Tier H (`AGENTS.md`) ⇒ draft PR, four-piece terminal, one authorized approval; line budget measured by the taker (this repository's `AGENTS.md` is 593 lines at c255b38 — any ratchet on it is read from its own gate), paid by deletion if one applies. Held under 北极星「优先级」第 3 条 with the lane's p2 tool cards while the product repos carry open P0 / P1.
